input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This phrase redundantly combines two time expressions; use the shorter time expression for an ancient-time setting. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，Use this plural noun when referring to a group of people rather than the generic noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了：看到了，Here the mother has perceived an effect, so the verb must mean “see/notice,” not “look at.” [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 同学们对孟子不好的影响：同学们对孟子的不好的影响，The adjective phrase modifying “influence” needs 的 before the noun it modifies. [rule: attributive_modifier_de]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：一个叫孟子的小男孩从小就，On a character’s first mention, introduce the character with a full noun phrase rather than using only the name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈：孟子和他的妈妈，After the name has appeared in the same clause, use a pronoun for the repeated possessor instead of repeating the name. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 老是对他开玩笑了：老是对他开玩笑，A habitual action with 老是 takes the zero particle, not 了, because it is not presented as completed. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
8. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：因为他每天只祭拜，所以没有朋友，The relationship is cause and effect, so use the paired connector because–therefore rather than 虽然. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: 古代的时候 redundantly combines a time noun with 的时候, and 在古代 is correct.
人 cannot refer by itself to this concrete group; 人们 is required here.
The intended meaning is that the mother noticed the influence, so 看到 is the appropriate verb.
的不好的影响 correctly marks 不好 as modifying 影响 in the intended noun phrase.
The first introduction should identify 孟子 with a fuller noun phrase, but the shown replacement ends with 从小就 and is incomplete by itself.
他的妈妈 avoids the unnecessarily repeated name and gives a correct reference to Mengzi's mother.
老是 describes a habitual action, so it should not take completed-action 了.
The sentence expresses cause and result, and 因为……所以…… correctly links the two clauses.
